title: NEBNext® ARTIC SARS-CoV-2 Library Prep - Bead Cleanup
author: Opentrons
materials: Pause. Put fresh plate on slot 2.

steps.title: Transfer sample to slot 3
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample from the plate on slot 2 to the plate on slot 3.

steps.title: Add beads to sample
steps.instruction: Transfer beads to the sample on slot 3.

steps.title: Engage magnet and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and remove the supernatant from the sample.

steps.title: Perform two washes
steps.instruction: Carry out two wash steps on the bead‑bound sample.

steps.title: Add elution buffer
steps.instruction: Add the elution solution to the beads.

steps.title: Pause and place fresh plate on slot 2
steps.instruction: Pause, then place a fresh plate onto slot 2.

steps.title: Transfer sample to fresh plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample from the current plate to the fresh plate on slot 2.
